result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.add_edge_by_id()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Add an edge between two nodes using their integer IDs. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L1272-L1372){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.add_edge_by_id( source, target, rel=None, weight=None, **attributes, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} A strict version of `add_edge()` that only accepts integer node IDs — no label resolution. Both source and target must be valid node IDs that already exist in the graph. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [source]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The source node ID (integer). [target]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The target node ID (integer). [rel]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional relationship type for the edge. [weight]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[float]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional edge weight. [**attributes]{.doc-parameter-name} : Arbitrary key-value pairs to store as edge attributes. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Returns self to enable method chaining. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [TypeError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If source or target is not an integer. [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If source or target node ID does not exist in the graph. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#c0b3df5b .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ec.Graph(directed=True) graph.add_node(label='Alice') graph.add_node(label='Bob') alice_id = graph.get_id_from_label('Alice') bob_id = graph.get_id_from_label('Bob') graph.add_edge_by_id( source=alice_id, target=bob_id, rel='follows' ) graph ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` Number of nodes : 2 Number of edges : 1 Directed : True Density : 0.50 Average degree (min, max) : 1.00 (1, 1) Strongly connected : False Weakly connected : True Number of strongly connected components : 2 Number of weakly connected components : 1 ``` ::: :::
